title: Deliver water during a presentation
robot: PAL Robotics TIAGo Dual with two Robotiq 2F-85 grippers
scope: MuJoCo integrates free objects and the passive hinge at 1 kHz. Robot joints track prescribed trajectories. The hand transfers use a compliant grasp constraint. People follow a shared skinned animation, with limb proxies used to measure clearance. Frames are sampled at 25 Hz.
description: A presenter gestures toward a chart and then pauses. TIAGo Dual either holds its supported water tray outside the presenter sight line until the break or rolls into the conference room before the presentation finishes.
notes: A presenter gestures toward a chart and then pauses. Both plans use the same person, initial layout and clock.
detail: Both detail views show 4.24 s. Unsafe replay · Interrupted sight line · 3.12 s. Safe replay · Interrupted sight line · 0.00 s.
criterion: The robot crosses a sight line between presenter and audience. The presentation break starts at 7.14 s in both runs. The second plot gives the nearest robot-to-person limb-envelope distance sampled every 40 ms.

steps.text: Approach with a water cup on the bolted service tray.
Wait outside the presenter’s sight line.
Pass the sight line once the presenter pauses.
Arrive with the cup on the service tray.
Approach with a water cup on the bolted service tray.
Continue past the decision point without yielding.
Cross the sight line during the presenter’s gesture.
Arrive with the cup on the service tray.
